廟會遶境經過，鞭炮、陣頭、神轎，整條路先暫停: A temple procession passes with firecrackers, performers and a palanquin. Road paused for now
遇到廟會遶境，順便求個收工平安: Met a temple procession, so why not pray for a safe clock-out
天空突然變黑，下起大雨，路面變滑了！: The sky went dark and it's pouring. The road is slippery!
出門還是大太陽，騎到一半突然暴雨: Bright sun when I left, then a sudden downpour halfway through the ride
低窪路段積水，騎進去會變超慢，最好繞路: Water on the low road. Riding in slows you way down, so better detour
衝進積水，師傅變落湯雞: Charged into the flood, and the pro is soaked
一棵樹倒在馬路上，暫時封路，請繞道: A tree fell across the road. Closed for now, take a detour
路被大樹擋住，師傅只能原地傻眼: A big tree blocks the road, and the pro just stares in disbelief
路上出現一個巨大坑洞，騎慢一點或繞過去: A giant pothole in the road. Ride slowly or go around
全速撞進坑洞，工具箱差點飛出去: Hit the pothole at full speed, and the toolbox almost flew out
